svg.text: Which SMB dialect you get, why SMB1 stays off, and who maps the drives at scale

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The client offers every dialect it has and the server picks the highest both speak; with SMB1 absent the ladder stops at 2.0.2, and Group Policy or Intune does the mapping for everyone.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: server speaks SMB 2 or 3. Enabling it needs an approved, scoped, time-boxed exception (risk: high).
